# Skeleton

The shape of content that is still on its way: shimmering bones in the layout the content will take, so nothing moves when it lands.

`NomNom.Skeleton` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Skeleton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Skeleton"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The shape of content that is still on its way: shimmering bones in the layout the content will take.

## Props (SkeletonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'list' \| 'card' \| 'text' \| 'row'` | list = a <Card layout="list"> of ListRow-shaped rows · card = a Card with a heading and lines · text = lines of body copy on the ground they sit on · row = o… |
| `rows` | `number` | Rows in a list: as many as the content usually has, so nothing jumps when it lands. @default 3 |
| `lines` | `number` | Lines in text and card. @default 3 |
| `leading` | `'avatar' \| 'photo'` | A row's leading bone, matching the ListRow it stands in for. |
| `trailing` | `boolean` | A row's trailing bone (a Badge, ScoreValue or button). |
| `meta` | `boolean` | false drops a row's second line. @default true |
| `caption` | `string` | One sentence under the bones for work that takes seconds ("Working out what to change"). Doubles as the accessible name. |
| `label` | `string` | The region's accessible name when there is no caption. @default 'Loading' |
